static float g_angle = 0.0f;

--- display_header ---
void display() {
  glClear(GL_COLOR_BUFFER_BIT | GL_DEPTH_BUFFER_BIT);
  glLoadIdentity();
  glPushAttrib(GL_ALL_ATTRIB_BITS);
  float A[8], B[8], C[8];
--- render_state ---
  glEnable(GL_MULTISAMPLE);
  glDisable(GL_LINE_SMOOTH);
--- camera ---
  glTranslatef(0.0000f, 0.0000f, -8.0000f);
  glRotatef(0.0000f, 1.0f, 0.0f, 0.0f);
  glRotatef(0.0000f, 0.0f, 1.0f, 0.0f);
  glTranslatef(-0.0000f, -0.0000f, -0.0000f);
--- header_post ---
--- source ---
  static float u;
  // collapse(dst, lo, hi, blend): collapse one Bezier edge in place.
  collapse(dst, lo, hi, blend) {
    A[dst] = A[lo] + (A[hi] - A[lo])*blend;
    B[dst] = B[lo] + (B[hi] - B[lo])*blend;
    C[dst] = C[lo] + (C[hi] - C[lo])*blend;
  }

  glClearColor(0.07, 0.08, 0.1, 1);
  glEnable(GL_DEPTH_TEST);
  glDisable(GL_LIGHTING);
  glLineWidth(3);
  // Seed A/B/C with control points, then overwrite them with collapse().
  glColor3f(1, 0.55, 0.2);
  glBegin(GL_LINE_STRIP);
    for(i, 0, 48) {
      A[0] = -3.2;
      B[0] = -1.8;
      C[0] = -0.8;
      A[1] = -1.1 + 0.4*sin(t*0.9);
      B[1] = 2.4;
      C[1] = -0.1;
      A[2] = 1.0;
      B[2] = -2.1 + 0.5*cos(t*0.7);
      C[2] = 0.5;
      A[3] = 3.1;
      B[3] = 1.6;
      C[3] = 1.0 + 0.25*sin(t*0.5);
      u = i/48.0;
      collapse(0, 0, 1, u);
      collapse(1, 1, 2, u);
      collapse(2, 2, 3, u);
      collapse(0, 0, 1, u);
      collapse(1, 1, 2, u);
      collapse(0, 0, 1, u);
      glVertex3f(A[0], B[0], C[0]);
    }
  glEnd();

  // Rebuild the same control polygon from scratch-array state.
  A[0] = -3.2;
  B[0] = -1.8;
  C[0] = -0.8;
  A[1] = -1.1 + 0.4*sin(t*0.9);
  B[1] = 2.4;
  C[1] = -0.1;
  A[2] = 1.0;
  B[2] = -2.1 + 0.5*cos(t*0.7);
  C[2] = 0.5;
  A[3] = 3.1;
  B[3] = 1.6;
  C[3] = 1.0 + 0.25*sin(t*0.5);
  glColor3f(0.25, 0.45, 0.95);
  glBegin(GL_LINE_STRIP);
    glVertex3f(A[0], B[0], C[0]);
    glVertex3f(A[1], B[1], C[1]);
    glVertex3f(A[2], B[2], C[2]);
    glVertex3f(A[3], B[3], C[3]);
  glEnd();
  glPointSize(9);
  glColor3f(1, 0.9, 0.35);
  glBegin(GL_POINTS);
    glVertex3f(A[0], B[0], C[0]);
    glVertex3f(A[1], B[1], C[1]);
    glVertex3f(A[2], B[2], C[2]);
    glVertex3f(A[3], B[3], C[3]);
  glEnd();
